rule: LO + CODE + '-' + XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. The 12th digit is a Luhn check digit. Payloads are random, never sequential. A code is never reused for another purpose.

types.name: Order
types.purpose: Purchase or checkout order; a POS sale is an order

types.name: Notification
types.purpose: Notification record (only where a public reference is needed)

types.name: Credential record
types.purpose: Reference to a credential record, never the credential itself

types.name: Conversation
types.purpose: Chat conversation, business or support route

types.name: Consent record
types.purpose: Consent, support-access grant or data-sharing grant

types.name: Customer reference
types.purpose: Merchant-scoped pseudonymous customer reference, never the LynkID

types.name: Physical companion card
types.purpose: Physical companion card. Linked to its virtual card in the database, never by composing IDs

types.name: Supplier score
types.purpose: Aggregated supplier score from settled card spend

types.name: Evidence pack
types.purpose: Evidence pack for one payment or dispute (LynkProof)

types.name: Business document
types.purpose: Payslip, tax return, commission statement, analytics report or saved dashboard, certificate, registration application (owner approved 2026-11-08)

types.name: Verified review
types.purpose: A customer review tied to a real receipt (LORCP-), one per receipt (owner approved 2026-11-08)

types.name: Storefront offer
types.purpose: One offer on a Storefront: a product, course, service, event or app offered to others (owner approved 2026-11-09, BIZZ & DEVICE)

types.name: Tracked or protected asset
types.purpose: A vehicle, container, piece of cargo or equipment tracked or protected in LynkGuard or LynkMotion (owner approved 2026-11-10, NEW UPDATE 1)

types.name: Trip or journey
types.purpose: One trip of a person, rider or vehicle, or a journey of several legs (owner approved 2026-11-10, NEW UPDATE 1)

types.name: LynkSentry incident
types.purpose: A security incident opened in LynkSentry: theft, tamper, crash or SOS (owner approved 2026-11-10, NEW UPDATE 1); never the platform status incident (INC)

types.name: Survey
types.purpose: A LynkSurvey survey, every version of it (owner locked 2026-11-11, NEW UPDATE 4)

types.name: Survey answer
types.purpose: One person's answer to a LynkSurvey survey; for an anonymous survey it is never linked to who answered (owner locked 2026-11-11, NEW UPDATE 4)

types.name: Visitor
types.purpose: A visitor signed in through LynkAttend (owner locked 2026-11-11, NEW UPDATE 4)

types.name: Attendance record
types.purpose: One LynkAttend check-in and its check-out (owner locked 2026-11-11, NEW UPDATE 4)
